decision: SCOPE -> W3: hunt first. The hunt FOUND two dry-bean-naming pages: WSU FS135E 'Growing Dry Beans in Home Gardens' (a PDF on wpcdn.web.wsu.edu: 'Plant seeds 2–3 inches apart in rows spaced 2–3 feet apart') and usu_ext beans-in-the-garden (HTML; names dry beans: 'leave dry beans on the plant until pods yellow and dry') "Plant seeds 1 inch deep, spaced 2-3 inches apart, in rows 18-24 inches wide." -> in_row [2,3], row [18,24]. The USU page is taken (HTML bytes; exact catalogued host); WSU corroborates 2-3. Clemson's snap-bean sentence (today's source) is not accepted since the hunt succeeded. Today's hi 4 rests on UMN's generic 'four inches apart'. The two scanner hits are yields per row: agrees. [SESSION 3 REVIEW, 2026-10-01: quote swapped from 'in rows 18-24 inches wide' (ambiguous: width or spacing) to the same page's 'All beans' paragraph: 'When soils are above 60ºF, space rows 18-24 inches apart and plant seeds 1 inch deep and 2-3 inches apart in the row.' Same figures.]
